settings.support.blurb.original: If you find this plugin useful, consider supporting its development:
settings.support.blurb.translation: Ma yella asiɣzef-agi yesɛa azal ɣur-k, xemmem ad tɛiwneḍ asnerni-ines:

settings.support.mission.original: …and help seed a bigger vision: technology that serves people and planet..
settings.support.mission.translation: …tɛiwneḍ daɣen ad nezreɛ tamuɣli tameqqrant: tatiknulujit i iqeddcen ɣef yemdanen d umtiweg.

settings.templates.templaterFile.name.translation: Afaylu n tmudemt n usiɣzef Templater

settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.original: Path to the templater plugin template file to use
settings.templates.templaterFile.desc.translation: Abrid ɣer ufaylu n tmudemt n usiɣzef Templater ara nesseqdec

settings.transcripts.info.original: Transcript settings control how and where your extracted notes are saved, which youtube data API key to use (required for channel/playlist processing), and optional language-translation parameters.
settings.transcripts.info.translation: Iɣewwaṛen n yiḍrisen ttwalin amek d anida ttwaḥerzen tezmilin-ik, tasarut API n yisefka YouTube ara nesseqdec (tilaq i yibuddar d tebdarin n turart), d iɣewwaṛen ifrayanen n usuqqel.

settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.original: The root folder where transcript subfolders will be organized (e.g., inbox, notes, etc.)
settings.transcripts.rootFolder.desc.translation: Akaram aẓar anda ara ttwaseggmen ikaramen i d-izeddin n yiḍrisen (am inbox, notes atg.)

settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.original: Your Google cloud console API key for accessing public YouTube transcripts (not an OAUTH token). Required for downloading channels and playlists.
settings.transcripts.youtubeApiKey.desc.translation: Tasarut-ik API n Google cloud console i unekcum ɣer yiḍrisen izuyaz n YouTube (mačči d ajiṭun OAUTH). Tilaq i usader n yibuddar d tebdarin n turart.

settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.original: Optional key for scrapecreators transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method. Get a free key at app.scrapecreators.com (100 requests free). Recommended for reliable transcript retrieval; direct YouTube extraction breaks when YouTube changes how captions are served.
settings.transcripts.scrapeCreatorsApiKe.translation: Tasarut tafrayant i umeẓlu n yiḍrisen scrapecreators. Ticki tettusbadu, tettuseqdac d tarrayt tagejdant. Awi tasarut baṭel deg app.scrapecreators.com (100 n yisutar baṭel). Tettwawelleh i yiḍrisen iṣeḥḥan; asekcem usrid seg YouTube yerreẓ ticki YouTube ibeddel amek i d-yettak iḍrisen n ddaw.

settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.original: Optional key for supadata transcript service. When set, used as the primary transcript method (if no scrapecreators key). Get a key at supadata.ai.
settings.transcripts.supadataApiKey.desc.translation: Tasarut tafrayant i umeẓlu n yiḍrisen supadata. Ticki tettusbadu, tettuseqdac d tarrayt tagejdant (ma ulac tasarut scrapecreators). Awi tasarut deg supadata.ai.

settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.original: Target language code for translation (e.g., en, es, fr, de). Use "en" to keep content in english.
settings.transcripts.translateLanguage.d.translation: Tangalt n tutlayt tasaḍest i usuqqel (am en, es, fr, de). Seqdec «en» akken ad yeqqim ugbur s teglizit.

settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.original: Target country/region code for translation (e.g., us, gb, ca). Used for region-specific language variants.
settings.transcripts.translateCountry.de.translation: Tangalt n tmurt neɣ n temnaḍt tasaḍest i usuqqel (am us, gb, ca). Tettuseqdac i lqem n tutlayt s temnaḍt.

settings.llm.info.original: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key, and pick a model. Temperature controls creativity; max tokens caps output length. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; Google's gemini-2.5-flash is cheaper, but its lower-cost tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.info.translation: Fren amefki AI, sekcem tasarut-is API, syen fren tamudelt. Tazɣelt tseddu tasnulfut; amḍan afellay n ijitunen isewḥel teɣzi n tuffɣa. Yettwawelleh OpenRouter ɣef twuridt-is; gemini-2.5-flash n Google d arxis, maca iswiren-is irxisen zemren ad ttwaḥebsen.

settings.llm.provider.desc.original: Provider used for summarization. OpenRouter is recommended for reliability; lower-cost Gemini tiers can be throttled.
settings.llm.provider.desc.translation: Amefki ara yesseqdec i ugzul. Yettwawelleh OpenRouter ɣef twuridt-is; iswiren irxisen n Gemini zemren ad ttwaḥebsen.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.original: Stored in Obsidian secret storage, not in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.cloud.translation: Yettwaḥrez deg uḥraz uffir n Obsidian, mačči deg yisefka n usiɣzef.

settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.original: Server URL, stored in plugin data.
settings.llm.apiKey.desc.ollama.translation: URL n uqeddac, yettwaḥrez deg yisefka n usiɣzef.

settings.llm.model.desc.original: Select a preset model or type a custom model name below.
settings.llm.model.desc.translation: Fren tamudelt tuheggit neɣ aru isem n tmudelt tudmawant ddaw-a.

settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.original: Required: this model isn't in the registry — set context window, max output, and reserve % so token budgeting can size requests safely.
settings.llm.modelParams.descCustom.translation: Ilaq: tamudelt-a ulac-itt deg ukaram — sbadu asfaylu n umnaḍ, tuffɣa tafellayt, d amḍan n uḥraz akken ad yili usmizeḍ n yijitunen s laman.

settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.original: These are this model's token limits, prefilled from known data. Edit a field to override it for this provider and model.
settings.llm.modelParams.descOverride.translation: Ha-t-an ilisa n yijitunen n tmudelt-a, ččuren-d seg yisefka yettwassnen. Ẓreg urti akken ad t-tesnifleḍ i umefki d tmudelt-a.

settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.original: Total context window in thousands of tokens (e.g., 400 for 400k tokens)
settings.llm.contextWindow.desc.translation: Asfaylu n umnaḍ ummid s walfat n yijitunen (am 400 i 400k n yijitunen)

settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.original: Maximum output tokens in thousands (e.g., 128 for 128k tokens)
settings.llm.maxOutput.desc.translation: Ijitunen n tuffɣa ufellay s walfat (am 128 i 128k n yijitunen)

settings.llm.inputMax.desc.original: Explicit input cap if vendor publishes one (leave empty to auto calculate)
settings.llm.inputMax.desc.translation: Talast tuzrirt n unekcum ma yella amefki yessufeɣ-itt (eǧǧ d ilem i usiḍen awurman)

settings.llm.reservePct.desc.original: Safety reserve for output tokens (0.10 = 10%, default: {default})
settings.llm.reservePct.desc.translation: Aḥraz n tɣellist i yijitunen n tuffɣa (0.10 = 10%, amezwer: {default})

settings.llm.temperature.desc.original: Controls randomness of output (0-1). Lower is more focused, higher is more creative. Current value: {value}
settings.llm.temperature.desc.translation: Yesseddu tarurbant n tuffɣa (0-1). Azal amejṭuḥ yettuẓẓig ugar, azal ameqqran yesnulfuy ugar. Azal amiran: {value}

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.name.translation: Rnu azemz send azwel n tzemmilt

settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.original: Automatically add date to the beginning of note filenames
settings.noteFormat.prependDate.desc.translation: Rnu s wudem awurman azemz deg tazwara n yismawen n yifuyla n tzemmilt

settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.original: Format for date prepended to note titles
settings.noteFormat.dateFormat.desc.translation: Amasal n uzemz i d-yettwarnan send izwal n tzemmilin

settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating fast summaries
settings.prompts.systemFast.desc.translation: Iwellihen i tikli n llms ticki d-snulfuyen igzulen iruraden

settings.prompts.userFast.desc.original: Specific instructions for summarizing the transcript quickly and concisely
settings.prompts.userFast.desc.translation: Iwellihen ussiden i ugzul n uḍris s zzerb d tewzel

settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.original: Please summarize the following YouTube transcript...
settings.prompts.userFast.placeholder.translation: Ttxil-k gzel aḍris YouTube i d-iteddun...

settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.original: Instructions for the llms behavior when generating detailed, comprehensive summaries
settings.prompts.systemExtensive.desc.translation: Iwellihen i tikli n llms ticki d-snulfuyen igzulen leqqayen d yemmden

settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.original: Specific instructions for creating detailed and structured notes from the transcript
settings.prompts.userExtensive.desc.translation: Iwellihen ussiden i tmerna n tzemmilin leqqayen d yesɣiwsen seg uḍris

settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.original: From the transcript below, create detailed and structured notes...
settings.prompts.userExtensive.placehold.translation: Seg uḍris ddaw-a, snulfu-d tizemmilin leqqayen d yesɣiwsen...

settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.original: Choose the default summary mode to use when the plugin starts. Fast summary mode skips timestamp links for quicker processing.
settings.prompts.defaultMode.desc.translation: Fren askar amezwer n ugzul ticki ibeddu usiɣzef. Askar arurad yettaǧǧa iseɣwan n tirect n wakud akken ad yezreb usesfer.

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.name.translation: Rnu iseɣwan n tirect n wakud YouTube

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.original: Add links to each numbered section heading that jump to the corresponding timestamp in the YouTube video (note: disabled in fast summary mode)
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.desc.translation: Rnu i yal azwel n tigzi yettwaṭṭfen s umḍan aseɣwen ara yawin ɣer tirect n wakud yemṣadan deg tvidyut YouTube (tamawt: yensa deg uskar n ugzul arurad)

settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.original: When enabled, reduces first pass tokens by 12% to make room for links. Automatically disabled in fast summary mode.
settings.prompts.timestampLinks.infoTool.translation: Ticki yermed, yesnaqas ijitunen n tikkelt tamezwarut s 12% akken ad yeǧǧ amkan i yiseɣwan. Yettensay s wudem awurman deg uskar n ugzul arurad.

settings.advanced.info.original: Advanced settings for debugging and troubleshooting. Enable debug logging to get detailed information appended to each note for technical support.
settings.advanced.info.translation: Iɣewwaṛen leqqayen i useɣti n tuccḍiwin. Rmed aɣmis n useɣti akken ad ternuḍ talɣut leqqayen i yal tazmilt i tallalt tatiknikt.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.original: Enable detailed debug logs. When enabled, debug information will be appended to each note as a hidden callout for troubleshooting.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.desc.translation: Rmed iɣmisen leqqayen n useɣti. Ticki yermed, talɣut n useɣti ad tettwarnu i yal tazmilt d tanaḍt tuffirt i useɣti n wuguren.

settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.original: When enabled, debug information will be collected and added to notes as a hidden callout instead of being logged to the console.
settings.advanced.debugLogging.infoToolt.translation: Ticki yermed, talɣut n useɣti ad d-tettwajmeɛ ad ternu ɣer tzemmilin d tanaḍt tuffirt, deg umkan n uɣmis ɣer tdiwennit.

license.modal.title.translation: Turagt n usiɣzef n yiḍrisen YouTube Tubesage

license.modal.loadError.original: Could not load license file. Please check that a license file exists in your plugin directory.
license.modal.loadError.translation: Ur yezmir ara ad d-yali ufaylu n turagt. Senqed ma yella ufaylu n turagt deg ukaram n usiɣzef-ik.

license.required.message.original: You must accept the plugin license before using this feature.
license.required.message.translation: Ilaq ad tqebleḍ turagt n usiɣzef send aseqdec n tmahilt-a.

license.required.instruction.original: Please go to the plugin settings and accept the license terms to continue.
license.required.instruction.translation: Ddu ɣer yiɣewwaṛen n usiɣzef, tqebleḍ tiwtilin n turagt akken ad tkemmleḍ.

license.required.step2.original: Scroll down to the "Community Plugins" section in the sidebar
license.required.step2.translation: Ader ɣer tigzi n yisiɣzaf n temɣiwent deg ufeggag idisan

license.required.step3.original: Find "Tubesage" in the Community Plugins list
license.required.step3.translation: Nadi «Tubesage» deg tebdart n yisiɣzaf n temɣiwent

license.required.step5.original: Toggle "Accept license & disclaimer" to enable the plugin
license.required.step5.translation: Rmed «Qbel turagt & tukksa n tmasit» akken ad yeddu usiɣzef

notice.apiKey.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin: no API key configured for {provider}. Add your API key in the plugin settings.
notice.apiKey.missing.translation: Asiɣzef n yiḍrisen Youtube: ulac tasarut API yettwaslen i {provider}. Rnu tasarut-ik API deg yiɣewwaṛen n usiɣzef.

notice.job.interrupted.original: Processing was interrupted; resume it from "Show active jobs"
notice.job.interrupted.translation: Asesfer yeḥbes; kemmel-it seg «Sken-d imahilen urmiden»

notice.debugNote.created.original: Error note created with debug information: {file}
notice.debugNote.created.translation: Tettwarna tzemmilt n tuccḍa s telɣut n usezreg: {file}

notice.debugNote.failed.original: Error: {error} (Also failed to create debug note)
notice.debugNote.failed.translation: Tuccḍa: {error} (ur tettwarna ara daɣen tzemmilt n usezreg)

notice.recovery.checkFailed.original: Could not check for interrupted jobs: {error}
notice.recovery.checkFailed.translation: Ur izmir ara ad isenqed imahilen yeḥbsen: {error}

notice.transcript.noTimestamps.original: Warning: No timestamps found in transcript. Timestamps are required for proper processing.
notice.transcript.noTimestamps.translation: Ɣur-k: ulac tirectiwin n wakud deg uḍris. Tirectiwin n wakud ilaqent i usesfer.

notice.templater.required.original: Error: Templater plugin is required but not installed or enabled
notice.templater.required.translation: Tuccḍa: ilaq usiɣzef Templater, maca ur yettwasbedd ara neɣ ur yermid ara

notice.templater.missing.original: Youtube transcript plugin requires the Templater plugin. Please install and enable it.
notice.templater.missing.translation: Asiɣzef n yiḍrisen Youtube yesra asiɣzef Templater. Sebded-it terniḍ sermed-it.

notice.collection.fetchingPlaylist.translation: Awway n tebdart n tɣuri, ID: {id}

notice.collection.safetyLimit.original: Reached safety limit of {limit} videos. Processing the first {limit} videos.
notice.collection.safetyLimit.translation: Yewweḍ talast n tɣellist n {limit} n tvidyutin. Ad ttwasefren {limit} n tvidyutin timezwura.

notice.timestamps.adding.translation: Timerna n yiseɣwan n tirectiwin n wakud s LLM...

notice.timestamps.retrying.translation: Aɛraḍ wis sin s talast n tsedditin tenqes...

notice.timestamps.failed.translation: Ur zmiren ara ad ttwarnun yiseɣwan n tirectiwin n wakud: {error}

notice.timestamps.added.original: Added timestamp links to {count} section headings
notice.timestamps.added.translation: Ttwarnan yiseɣwan n tirectiwin n wakud ɣer yizwal n tgezmiwin, amḍan: {count}

notice.translate.emptyResponse.original: Failed to translate content (empty response from LLM)
notice.translate.emptyResponse.translation: Ur yezmir ara ad isuqqel agbur (tiririt tilemt seg LLM)

notice.models.apiKeyMissing.original: {provider} API key is missing. Cannot fetch models.
notice.models.apiKeyMissing.translation: Ulac tasarut API n {provider}. Ur izmir ara ad d-yawi timudelin.

notice.models.fetchFailed.translation: Ur yeddi ara wawway n tmudelin n {provider}: {error}

notice.models.parseFailed.original: Could not parse {provider} models from API response.
notice.models.parseFailed.translation: Ur izmir ara ad iɣer timudelin n {provider} seg tririt n API.

notice.models.error.translation: Tuccḍa deg wawway n tmudelin n {provider}: {error}

notice.timestamps.addedChunked.original: Added {count} timestamp links using chunked processing
notice.timestamps.addedChunked.translation: Ttwarnan yiseɣwan n tirectiwin n wakud s usesfer s tsekkiwin, amḍan: {count}

modal.create.titlePlaceholder.original: Leave empty to use YouTube title
modal.create.titlePlaceholder.translation: Eǧǧ-it d ilem akken ad tesqedceḍ azwel n YouTube

modal.create.urlInvalid.original: Not a valid YouTube URL. Only video, playlist, and channel urls are supported.
modal.create.urlInvalid.translation: Mačči d tansa YouTube tameɣtut. Ttwasferken kan tansiwin n tvidyut, n tebdart d ubadu.

modal.create.title.original: Tubesage: create note from YouTube transcript
modal.create.title.translation: Tubesage: snulfu-d tazmilt seg uwennit n YouTube

modal.create.urlPlaylist.original: YouTube channel or playlist URL detected
modal.create.urlPlaylist.translation: Yettwaf URL n ubadu neɣ n tebdart n YouTube

modal.create.urlVideo.translation: Yettwaf URL n tvidyut n YouTube

modal.create.videoCountPrompt.original: How many videos would you like to process? Max hard limit is 50.
modal.create.videoCountPrompt.translation: Acḥal n tvidyutin ara tsesfeḍ? Talast tafellayt d 50.

modal.create.fastModeDesc.original: Enable for shorter, quicker summaries (skips timestamp links)
modal.create.fastModeDesc.translation: Igzulen wruzzinen imaynuten (yettuɣal ɣef izdayen n wakud)

modal.jobs.loadError.original: Could not read the job list: {error}
modal.jobs.loadError.translation: Ur izmir ara ad iɣer tabdart n iwuriwen: {error}

modal.jobs.discardHint.original: Discard removes a job from this list; it never deletes notes.
modal.jobs.discardHint.translation: «Kkes» ikkes kan awuri seg tebdart-a; werǧin itekkes tizmilin.

modal.templatePicker.empty.original: No template files found in "{folder}" folder. Make sure your template folder is correctly configured in Templater settings.
modal.templatePicker.empty.translation: Ulac ifuyla n tneɣrufin deg ukaram «{folder}». Senqed ma yella ukaram n tneɣrufin yettwasbadu akken iwata deg yiɣewwaren n Templater.

modal.readme.title.translation: Tasemlit n uzegrir Tubesage n uwennit n YouTube

modal.readme.loadError.original: Could not load readme file. Please check that readme.md exists in your plugin directory.
modal.readme.loadError.translation: Ur nezmir ara ad d-nesali afaylu readme. Senqed ma yella readme.md deg ukaram n uzegrir.

modal.template.title.original: Example template: copy and place in your templater plugin specified template directory
modal.template.title.translation: Taneɣruft n umedya: nɣel-itt ɣer ukaram n tneɣrufin yettwabedren deg Templater

modal.template.explanation.original: This is the example templater plugin template used for YouTube transcript notes. You can customize this template for your own needs.
modal.template.explanation.translation: Tagi d taneɣruft n umedya n Templater i tezmilin n uwennit n YouTube. Tzemreḍ ad tt-tesnifleḍ akken i ak-yehwa.

modal.template.loadError.original: Could not load template file. Please check that the template exists in your plugin directory or vault templates folder.
modal.template.loadError.translation: Ur nezmir ara ad d-nesali afaylu n tneɣruft. Senqed ma yella deg ukaram n uzegrir neɣ deg ukaram n tneɣrufin n tsenduqt.

notice.collection.extractingName.translation: Yettwawi-d yisem n tebdart n urar…

notice.collection.start.playlist.translation: Yebda usesfeḍ n tebdart n urar n YouTube: {name}

notice.collection.start.channel.translation: Yebda usesfeḍ n ubadu n YouTube: {name}

notice.collection.folderCreated.playlist.translation: Yettwarna ukaram n tebdart n urar: {path}

notice.collection.fetchingFrom.playlist.translation: Yettwawin-d tividyutin seg tebdart n urar: {name}

notice.collection.addingTimestamps.playl.original: Adding timestamp links to playlist video: {title}
notice.collection.addingTimestamps.playl.translation: Yettwarna izdayen n wakud ɣer tvidyut n tebdart n urar: {title}

notice.collection.addingTimestamps.chann.original: Adding timestamp links to channel video: {title}
notice.collection.addingTimestamps.chann.translation: Yettwarna izdayen n wakud ɣer tvidyut n ubadu: {title}

notice.collection.timestampsFailed.original: Note created but timestamps could not be added to "{title}"
notice.collection.timestampsFailed.translation: Tazmilt tettwarna, maca ur nezmir ara ad nernu icudam n wakud ɣer «{title}»

notice.collection.complete.original: Channel processing complete: {processed} processed, {skipped} skipped, {errors} errors
notice.collection.complete.translation: Yekfa usesfeḍ n ubadu – yettwasesfeḍ: {processed}, yettwazgel: {skipped}, tuccḍiwin: {errors}

notice.job.saveFailed.original: Could not save the job: {error}. The video may still be processing; check "Show active jobs"
notice.job.saveFailed.translation: Ur nezmir ara ad nesekles awuri: {error}. Ahat tvidyut mazal tettusesfaḍ; wali «Sken-d imahilen urmiden»

notice.job.alreadyRunning.original: This video is already being processed

notice.job.cannotResume.original: This job cannot be resumed as it is; see its status
notice.job.cannotResume.translation: Awuri-a ur yezmir ara ad ikemmel akka; wali addad-is

notice.job.cannotFinish.original: This job cannot be finished as it is; see its status
notice.job.cannotFinish.translation: Awuri-a ur yezmir ara ad yemmed akka; wali addad-is

modal.template.var.title.desc.original: - The title of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.videoUrl.desc.original: - The URL of the Youtube video

modal.template.var.transcript.desc.translation: - Awennit ummid s icudam n wakud

modal.template.var.summary.desc.original: - The LLM-generated summary of the video
modal.template.var.summary.desc.translation: - Agzul n tvidyut i d-yeffɣen seg LLM

modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.original: - The LLM provider used (e.g., openai, anthropic)
modal.template.var.llmProvider.desc.translation: - Asemmaway n LLM yettwasqedcen (amedya openai, anthropic)

modal.template.var.llmModel.desc.original: - The specific model used (e.g., gpt-4, claude-3-opus)

modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.original: - Tags generated from the LLM provider and model
modal.template.var.llmTags.desc.translation: - Tibzimin i d-yeffɣen seg usemmaway d tmudemt n LLM

notice.models.providerSet.original: Provider set to {provider}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.providerSet.translation: Asaǧǧaw yettwasbadu ɣer {provider}. Tasmekta n tuffɣa: {tokens} n tokens (tuffɣa tafellayt nnger uḥraz).

notice.models.modelChanged.original: Model changed to {model}. Output budget: {tokens} tokens (max output minus reserve).
notice.models.modelChanged.translation: Tamudemt tbeddel ɣer {model}. Tasmekta n tuffɣa: {tokens} n tokens (tuffɣa tafellayt nnger uḥraz).

notice.models.refreshFailed.original: Could not refresh {provider} models. Using existing list.
notice.models.refreshFailed.translation: Ur yezmir ara ad yesmiren timudmin {provider}. Ad tettwaseqdec tebdart yellan.

notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.original: No videos found in this playlist
notice.collection.noVideos.playlist.translation: Ulac tividyutin i yettwafen deg tebdart-a n tɣuri

notice.collection.noVideos.channel.original: No videos found in this channel
notice.collection.noVideos.channel.translation: Ulac tividyutin i yettwafen deg ubadu-a

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.one.original: {provider} model list refreshed. Token limits auto-populated for {count} model.
notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.one.translation: Tabdart n tmudmin {provider} tettwasmiren. Tilisa n tokens ttwaččuren s wudem awurman i {count} n tmudemt.

notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.original: {provider} model list refreshed. Token limits auto-populated for {count} models.
notice.models.refreshedWithLimits.other.translation: Tabdart n tmudmin {provider} tettwasmiren. Tilisa n tokens ttwaččuren s wudem awurman i {count} n tmudmin.

modal.jobs.closed.noNote.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; no note was created
modal.jobs.closed.noNote.translation: Yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian; ulac tazmilt i yettwarnan

modal.jobs.closed.mayExist.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; a note may exist at {path}
modal.jobs.closed.mayExist.translation: Yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian; ahat tella tazmilt deg {path}

modal.jobs.closed.withoutTimestamps.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; the note was created without timestamps
modal.jobs.closed.withoutTimestamps.translation: Yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian; tazmilt tettwarna war tikkalin n wakud

modal.jobs.closed.withoutTranslation.original: Interrupted when Obsidian closed; the note was created without translation
modal.jobs.closed.withoutTranslation.translation: Yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian; tazmilt tettwarna war asuqqel

modal.jobs.reason.paidStageInFlight.original: Interrupted during {stage}; the previous request may already have been billed
modal.jobs.reason.paidStageInFlight.translation: Yeḥbes deg {stage}; ahat yettwaxlaṣ yakan usuter yezrin

modal.jobs.reason.unknownBilling.original: Interrupted during {stage}; billing for the previous request is unknown
modal.jobs.reason.unknownBilling.translation: Yeḥbes deg {stage}; ur nessin ara ma yettwaxlaṣ usuter yezrin

modal.jobs.reason.noteCollision.original: A note already exists at the target path — rename or remove it, then resume from Show active jobs
modal.jobs.reason.noteCollision.translation: Tella yakan tazmilt deg ubrid iswi — beddel isem-is neɣ kkes-itt, syen kemmel seg «Sken-d imahilen urmiden»

modal.jobs.reason.claimUnresolved.original: Could not confirm whether the note at the target path belongs to this job
modal.jobs.reason.claimUnresolved.translation: Ur yezmir ara ad yesgezzi ma tazmilt n ubrid iswi n uxeddim-a

modal.jobs.reason.noteMissing.original: The note for this job was moved or deleted
modal.jobs.reason.noteMissing.translation: Tazmilt n uxeddim-a tettwasmutti neɣ tettwakkes

modal.jobs.reason.noteChanged.original: The note was edited during processing; timestamps were skipped
modal.jobs.reason.noteChanged.translation: Tazmilt tettwaẓreg deg usesfer; tikkalin n wakud ttwasurfent

modal.jobs.reason.templaterUnavailable.original: Templater is not available; enable it, then resume

modal.jobs.reason.paidRefetch.original: Resuming re-fetches the transcript through a paid service
modal.jobs.reason.paidRefetch.translation: Akemmel ad d-yawi aserɣu tikkelt nniḍen s useqdec n useqdac yettwaxelṣen

modal.jobs.reason.pathDrift.original: The note path could not be computed consistently (check folder and date settings), then resume
modal.jobs.reason.pathDrift.translation: Abrid n tzemmilt ur yezmir ara ad yettwasiḍen s wudem yemṣadan (senqed iɣewwaren n ukaram d uzemz), syen kemmel

notice.note.done.created.translation: Tazmilt n userɣu tettwarna akken iwata

notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.timestampsEdited.translation: Tazmilt tettwarna, maca tikkalin n wakud ttwasurfent acku tazmilt tettwaẓreg

notice.note.done.translationEdited.original: Note created, but the translation was skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.translationEdited.translation: Tazmilt tettwarna, maca asuqqel yettwasuref acku tazmilt tettwaẓreg

notice.note.done.bothEdited.original: Note created, but timestamps and the translation were skipped because the note was edited
notice.note.done.bothEdited.translation: Tazmilt tettwarna, maca tikkalin n wakud d usuqqel ttwasurfen acku tazmilt tettwaẓreg

notice.note.done.withoutBoth.original: Note created without timestamps or translation
notice.note.done.withoutBoth.translation: Tazmilt tettwarna war tikkalin n wakud war asuqqel

notice.coldStart.single.noNote.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: no note was created
notice.coldStart.single.noNote.translation: TubeSage: 1 n uxeddim n tzemmilt yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian — {title}: ulac tazmilt i yettwarnan

notice.coldStart.single.mayExist.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: a note may exist at {path}
notice.coldStart.single.mayExist.translation: TubeSage: 1 n uxeddim n tzemmilt yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian — {title}: ahat tella tazmilt deg {path}

notice.coldStart.single.withoutTimestamp.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: note was created without timestamps
notice.coldStart.single.withoutTimestamp.translation: TubeSage: 1 n uxeddim n tzemmilt yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian — {title}: tazmilt tettwarna war tikkalin n wakud

notice.coldStart.single.withoutTranslati.original: TubeSage: 1 note job was interrupted when Obsidian closed — {title}: note was created without translation
notice.coldStart.single.withoutTranslati.translation: TubeSage: 1 n uxeddim n tzemmilt yeḥbes mi yemdel Obsidian — {title}: tazmilt tettwarna war asuqqel

notice.coldStart.several.original: TubeSage: {count} note jobs were interrupted when Obsidian closed; the most recent are listed under Show active jobs
notice.coldStart.several.translation: TubeSage: {count} n yixeddimen n tzemmilin ḥebsen mi yemdel Obsidian; wid imaynuten llan deg «Sken-d imahilen urmiden»

notice.recovery.single.translation: TubeSage: 1 n uxeddim yeḥbes yesra lewsaya

notice.recovery.several.translation: TubeSage: {count} n yixeddimen ḥebsen sran lewsaya

common.transcript.unavailable.original: No transcript is available for this video
